name: com.b4u.blockly
description: Native C# port of Blockly: block model, JSON/XML serialization, UGUI rendering and interpreter.

samples.description: Adds two custom blocks (a dice roll and a shout) with their interpreter handlers and a toolbox category.
A component that applies a block theme (a built-in Candy look, or your own BlockTheme asset), and example themes.

The Purple theme, a look taken from a design: dark panels, an icon rail that collapses, gradient category plates, a delete panel, Poppins. Add the PurpleSkin component to a scene (it brings its icons and font).
